message.content: In research_summary.md, the claim "Monocrystalline crystalline silicon (mono‑c‑Si): commonly 20–24% module efficiency…" is presented without defining measurement conditions (STC vs field/NOCT), whether values refer to cell vs module vs nameplate/system, or the date/source for the quoted range, which will mislead the standup when we try to pick an angle and audience. I will add a compact "metrics & context" box that defines STC/NOCT/aperture vs active area, clarifies cell/module/system distinctions, and annotates each percentage with its source and date so we can choose an appropriate technical level for the report.
